qwen3.8-27b-iq3_xxs.notes: Dense Qwen3.8 27B (llama.cpp arch qwen35) from ISTA-DASLab's IQ3_XXS file, read in place by strata-poly (or aryainfer) with its draft block and 1,024-token vision.  128K context on a 4-bit cache with a 512-row prompt batch: measured on this host 2026-11-03, a 61,787-token prompt read at 826.0 tok/s and wrote at ~70 tok/s with the vision encoder on the CPU and 14.7 GiB of VRAM; the same prompt read at 722.2 tok/s with the encoder on the card, and the old 2,048-row batch decoded at 32.0 at 64K.  Calibrated for coding on this host: temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, thinking budget 1536, loop recovery on; 7 of 7 code probes and 3 of 3 answer-only probes passed.

qwen3.8-27b-iq2_s.notes: The same model from the smaller IQ2_S file, for the long prompts: 200,069-token context on a 4-bit cache, measured here with the needle found at 417.3 tok/s reading and 14.6 tok/s writing. Calibrated for coding on this host (2026-11-02): temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, thinking budget 1536, loop recovery on; 7 of 7 code probes and 3 of 3 answer-only probes passed, and the repetition bait stopped on its own. Thinking modes off, low, medium and high are supported (default medium, thinking cap 4096); measured on this host 2026-11-02: every graded level passed all six probes on both files, off passed four of six and five of six, and the deep levels think most.

qwen3.8-27b-arya.notes: The same IQ3_XXS file on AryaInfer's own engine binary (aryainfer.exe), which is built from this repo so the fork's changes have a home while strata-poly stays exactly as PolyStrata ships it. Same protocol, flags, READY line and auto-switching as the poly engine; 128K with a 4-bit cache and a 512-row prompt batch (722.2 tok/s reading and 70.3 writing on a 61,833-token prompt with GPU vision; 826.0 reading with the encoder on the CPU). The fork's build compiles the chunked GDN MMA kernel that upstream's installed 0.1.45 lacks; the model config enables it with STRATA_GDN_MMA=1, measured on this host 2026-11-03 at +8-9% reading (1,190.0 -> 1,287.8 at 8K, 1,021.4 -> 1,114.5 at 32K, 854.9 -> 917.8 at 62K) with decode unchanged by the kernel.

qwen3.8-27b-aq3.display_name: AryaInfer Qwen3.8 27B GSQ3 AQ3 - 128K vision (Arya engine, faster writing)
qwen3.8-27b-aq3.notes: ISTA-DASLab's 3-bit GSQ checkpoint repacked as AQ3 (tools/aryainfer_gsq3_convert.py), uniform 3-bit with a scale per 128, read only by aryainfer.exe. Measured on this host 2026-11-03, final build: reading 1,444-1,633 tok/s at 8K (batch 2,048; 1,266 at batch 512, 711 before the Q8_0 expansion was made coalesced) and 1,153.9-1,175.0 on a 62K prompt (batch 2,048, 64K context; 990 before the attention work); 968.7 on a 61,787-token prompt through the server at 131K context (15.2 GiB, before that work); writing 88-104 tok/s at 8K. The prompt attention keeps its scores as halves and uses bigger key blocks, taking its share of 62K prefill from 39% (24.4 s) to 35% (18.8 s). Entry paths repaired 2026-11-03 (they held UNC paths that do not resolve) and the vision encoder points at the AQ3 file; an image turn was checked. Batch 1024 is its setting: 2048 at 131K would add ~1.4 GiB on a card that measured 15.2 GiB.
